title: Average Grade
prompt: students is given. Print each student's name and the average of their grades as name: avg (rounded to 1 decimal) — two lines, f-strings shine here.

tests.name: prints averages
tests.code:
assert len(printed) == 2, f"expected two lines, got {printed}"
assert "8.0" in printed[0], f"Minh avg 8.0, got {printed[0]}"
assert "9.5" in printed[1], f"Lan avg 9.5, got {printed[1]}"
assert "Minh" in printed[0] and "Lan" in printed[1], f"names must appear, got {printed}"
